reviewer: independent intake_audit agent; no product edits or Git ref mutations
disposition: accepted within the documented bounded source-adapter and native operation contract
compiler_review: Only the selected Word paragraph ListFormat object admits the new setter and methods; static receiver/member checks retain source-language isolation.
ListLevelNumber exact numeric 1..9 values lower to native 0..8; strings, Booleans, live reads, Set, indexed property forms, invalid shapes, and unsupported optional behaviors remain refused.

Assignment intentionally retains existing scalar RHS-then-selector order exactly once, while methods evaluate the receiver first; explicit regression tests and documentation disclose this adapter contract without claiming COM conformance.
Aliases, ByVal selector passing, nested With, step/execution budgets, method arity and named argument checks reuse existing adapter mechanisms.
native_review: New operations validate detached state before publishing. Level changes preserve list identity and original native definitions, and resolve actual supported target indentation.

Missing lists/levels, boundaries, pending restart, duplicate/partial definitions, unsupported formats/linked or legacy semantics, forward/repeated counter references and invalid ancestor starts refuse atomically.
Outline identity uses explicit metadata and validated numeric levels; generated default reuse checks the entire scheme and IDs are allocated against existing references.

Foreign source metadata, right indentation ownership/inheritance and imported definition identity are tested across save/reopen; whole numbering-part byte identity is not promised for arbitrary raw input.
Inherited logical/character geometry and positive firstLine with hanging precedence are guarded; derived labels are recomputed on ordinary reopen.
Existing unbalanced-field and opaque-package preservation guards are retained rather than broad serializer behavior being changed by these new operations.

resolved_findings.finding: A hanging attribute, including zero, can suppress a positive firstLine in Word; inherited character/logical/hanging geometry can outrank new physical values.
resolved_findings.resolution: Positive firstLine writes omit hanging entirely; conflicting target/inherited hanging and inherited logical/character attributes are refused before publication. Independent probes cover successful and refused paths.

resolved_findings.finding: Ancestor placeholders require valid referenced ancestor start overrides, not only selected-level checks.
resolved_findings.resolution: checkedLevel validates ancestor starts recursively with strictly decreasing level references; duplicate/nonpositive starts refuse and positive preserved starts pass.

resolved_findings.finding: Ordinary serialization can normalize XML and add absent legacy numbering defaults, so raw complete-part byte equality overstates preservation.
resolved_findings.resolution: Documentation distinguishes unchanged original definitions from serializer normalization; raw-import tests compare complete original definition and instance nodes while normalized fixtures can compare full-part bytes.

resolved_findings.finding: Generic serialization materializes inherited right indentation when list projection changes the aggregate indentation snapshot.
resolved_findings.resolution: New geometry paths retain original right-family direct ownership when imported right is unchanged; explicit prior writes remain direct. Independent probes follow with later style edits and repeated reopen.

resolved_findings.finding: Detached effective indentation can lose a native prefix binding and cause generic property serialization to replace foreign indentation metadata.
resolved_findings.resolution: A new native-ind projection normalizes native attribute names only in detached effective geometry, alongside the unchanged numPr namespace-context projection. Raw direct/style XML remains intact and foreign ind lookalikes stay opaque. The final new-operation source, plain import, inherited style and rebound-prefix preservation probes were reviewed together; raw metadata and effective right/left/hanging values survive the operation and two additional save/reopen cycles.

resolved_findings.finding: The third paragraph in the example applied a toggle without explicit removal and failed on its own prior output.
resolved_findings.resolution: The example now explicitly removes paragraph numbering on all three selected paragraphs, with replay validation.

verification_scope.native_and_compiler_suites: Source coverage reviewed; owner/root execution receipts provide authoritative suite counts.
verification_scope.portable: Portable runner and integration assertions reviewed, including exact BAS, dry run, atomic publication/rollback, DOCM/VBA opaque preservation, native IDs/definitions and replay; root/owner VM-JS receipts qualify execution.
